name: Andrea Kuki-Murakami
original_name: アンドレア・クキ＝ムラカミ
source:
Profession: Pirate King
Country: Leader of the Andrea Pirates
Race: Human
Height: Tall
Breast size: Really Big

No law on earth reaches the ocean. The sea belongs to  pirates. Andrea is a young woman who has become a builder of her own pirate crew that rules the seven seas. She became the Pirate King not because of her power, but because of her dexterity. 

She wanted a child to succeed her because peace had come to the sea. However, she is a woman who is afraid of even the rough sea, so it is difficult to get a man and raise a child for long term. For the first time in her life, she decided to go up to ashore. If you're a legendary hero, you might be the right man for her.

「I wondered what a land man was like, you arent so bad. I might have become a little interested in having children...」
